policies.name: club_opening_funding_owner_read
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clubs c
  WHERE ((c.id = club_opening_setup_funding.club_id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'superadmin'::text, 'god'::text]))))))
